description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Route53::DelegationSet. Creates a reusable delegation set (a group of four name servers) that can be associated with multiple hosted zones.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the delegation set.

Id.description: The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigns to a reusable delegation set.

CallerReference.description: A unique string that identifies the request and allows retrying failed CreateReusableDelegationSet requests without risk of executing the operation twice.

NameServers.description: A list of the authoritative name servers for the delegation set.
